NGS_001_library_prep_input.description: dsDNA input concentration for NGS library prep (Qubit HS)

ELISA_001_tmb_endpoint.description: ELISA endpoint absorbance at 450 nm (Tecan Spark). Floor from library criterion 'negative control OD < 0.1 above blank'; ceiling = reader linear range. Curve-level acceptance (R2, CV) lives in the assay definition.

NGS_002_library_fragment_size.description: Library average fragment size (TapeStation). Range verbatim from robotic-assays field_03 AMPure post-PCR criteria.

NGS_003_pooling_input.description: dsDNA concentration acceptable for downstream pooling (Qubit HS). Range verbatim from robotic-assays field_03 Qubit quantification criteria.

PROT_001_expression_fluorescence.description: Reporter fluorescence endpoint (BMG CLARIOstar). Plausibility gate only — the assay-level criterion is relative (signal/background >= 5x per library HTS criteria).

PROT_002_bca_od562.description: BCA protein assay absorbance at 562 nm. Floor from library criterion 'blank OD562 < 0.10'; ceiling = reader linear range. Curve-level acceptance (R2 >= 0.995, CV) lives in the assay definition.
